_about: Issue 184: the three candidate looks for the starting bath towel, generated by scripts/outfit-options.mjs (run by `npm run tools -- options`) into this folder as towel-<letter>-<state>-<dir>.sprite and towel-<letter>-<pose>.sprite. Look A is also what the game ships by default (the `towel` entry of art/outfits.json). The letters are palette keys: i sky, 5 mist, 6 paper, a skin.

outfits.label: A wrap: a big sky-blue bath towel wrapped from the chest to above the knees, bare shoulders, arms and lower legs.
outfits.describe: towel look A: a sky-blue bath towel wrapped from the chest to above the knees, bare arms and lower legs

outfits.label: B wrap and turban: the same wrap, and a small sky-blue towel wound round the head over the hair.
outfits.describe: towel look B: the wrap and a small towel turban on the head

outfits.label: C cape: a sky-blue towel draped over the shoulders like a cape, bare chest between its ends, over the everyday jeans, a white edge.
outfits.describe: towel look C: a towel draped over the shoulders like a cape over the everyday trousers
